summation.displayName: NRAGE, NRIF, NADE, TRAF6 mediate, through unclear mechanisms...
summation.text: NRAGE, NRIF, NADE, TRAF6 mediate, through unclear mechanisms, MAPK8 (aka JNK) activation by threonine and tyrosine phosphorylation. While active (phosphorylated) MAPK8 moves to the nucleus and phosphorylates transcription factors such as c-JUN and ATF2, these have not been implicated in p75-mediated cell death. p75 activates the intrinsic caspase pathway (involving mitochondrial release of cytochrome c, Apaf-1, and caspases-9) rather than the extrinsic (caspase-8) pathway activated by most other death receptors (Troy et al. 2002).
